title: Anyone else messing around with Jex AI on Local Trade?
author: Plastic-Bluejay5047
selftext: Been testing beta for a few days now. mostly using it when I'm looking at market stuff and want a quick second opinion without opening 15 tabs lol. it's definitely still beta though. sometimes answers is useful, sometimes i have to ask the same thing differently cause it misses what i mean. wouldn't use it as some tell me what to buy machine either. anyone been using it longer?

comments.author: Worried_Morning_5148
comments.body: yeah, I've been poking at it for about a week, mostly for market questions when I don't feel like digging through a bunch of stuff myself. still hit or miss, but I've had a couple decent answers

comments.author: ClubImpressive3595
comments.body: same, I wouldn't call it something I rely on yet, but that's probably not the point while it's still beta. I actually found it more useful for sanity-checking and idea than asking broad stuff like what's happening with btc
